title: Connection at different levels.
officialText:
Where the fixture drains connect at different levels, the vent shall connect as a vertical
extension of the vertical drain. The vertical drain pipe connecting the two fixture drains shall be considered the vent for the lower
fixture drain, and shall be sized in accordance with Table 908.3. The upper fixture shall not be a water closet.
TABLE 908.3
COMMON VENT SIZES
MAXIMUM DISCHARGE FROM
PIPE SIZE (inches) UPPER FIXTURE DRAIN (dfu)
11/2 1
2 4
21/2 to 3 6
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm.
SECTION PC 909
WET VENTING
